title: Low poly mech references
summary: The owner selected the same original reference used in [Prototype Player Mech](#/prototype-player-mech/1). For this exploration, remove the weapons and other external equipment and simplify the mech into low poly forms.

items.title: Original mech reference
items.alt: Original charcoal mech photograph with a handheld gun, two back weapons and an arm shield.
items.body:
The same owner-supplied photograph from Prototype Player Mech. **Primary design reference.** Preserve the recognizable proportions, major armor shapes, palette and simplified main markings.

Remove the handheld gun, both back weapons, the shield and their attachments, plus other external equipment. Local copy; the earlier card is unchanged.

items.title: Neutral front guide ? earlier v001
items.alt: Detailed charcoal mech in a neutral front A-pose on white with empty hands and no gun, back weapons or shield.
items.body: Copied from the earlier card as a supporting guide for neutral front pose, framing and weapon removal. The original photograph remains the design source. This detailed guide is an earlier image, not a new low poly result.
